newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The government may decide today that the Compensation Office should finish its operations next year.
- A senior environmental ministry official said that Hungary would meet the European Union's environmental protection requirements within five years.
- Hungary spends the less money on research and development among Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA) countries, the government agency National Technical Development Committee (OMFB) said.
- Private pension funds are allowed to begin operation from January 1, 1998, but the deadline for employees to decide on fund membership is July 1, 1998.
